newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close soft ahead of Bengali New Year.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close soft ahead of Bengali New Year.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down amid selling pressure ahead of the Bengali New Year on Monday, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index fell 18.20 points or 1.64 percent at 1,089.09. Decliners led gainers by 88 to 30. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.

"Investors mostly refrained from making fresh commitments. There was a selling pressure because the poeple wanted to cash in their shares to celebrate the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival later this week," said one broker.
National Tubes gained 1.24 taka to 1,302, National Tea Company shed 27 to 352 and Beximcp Textiles lost 4.38 to 132.24.
